svg.title: Pastry Pirates — V3 · The Round Table — Sheet with the scooped corners — 2.8 mm, 22 parts
svg.desc: Sheet with the scooped corners: about 188 × 298 mm with 20 mm scooped corners, 2.8 mm ply, read off the steel rule in his photo. The file's top-left is the sheet's top-left as it lay in the photo, rule along the top. 7 mm from every edge, 3 mm between parts. 22 parts. Units: mm. 23.35 mm squares, 5.9 mm material. KERF-COMPENSATED: every cut line pushed 0.04 mm off the kept wood (kerf 0.08 mm) — cut on the line. RASTER = black fill (engrave), CUT = red hairline (cut). Generated by physical-board/generate.mjs.
